verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs say it can run A/B, multivariate, and bandit tests (amplitude-docs-41), including visual A/B tests on any page (amplitude-docs-7, amplitude-docs-20), and that results measure causal lift across variants (amplitude-docs-25). Data-driven release decisions are backed by these tests (amplitude-docs-28). Goal metrics and significance reporting are only implied by 'measure causal lift', not described directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of goal/primary metric configuration, explicit statistical significance or confidence reporting on results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
